import 'dart:async';
Future<void> inOrder<E>(Iterable<E> items, FutureOr<void> Function(E item) step, {required String reason}) async { for (final item in items) {
  await step(item);
} }

Future<void> use() async {
  await inOrder([], (value) async {}, reason: "Each update reads the previous write");
}
